YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_DAGGER.description:
A [gold]Stance[/gold]. When a card with the [gold]Dagger[/gold] tag attacks, apply [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Bleed[/gold] to the target.
Playing a card with the [gold]Dagger[/gold] tag grants [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dagger[/gold], up to [blue]12[/blue] stacks.
On exit, deal [blue]4[/blue] damage to a random enemy, repeated [gold]Dagger stacks[/gold] times.
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_DAGGER.title: Dagger
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_AXE.description:
A [gold]Stance[/gold]. Playing a card with the [gold]Axe[/gold] tag grants [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Axe[/gold], up to [blue]8[/blue] stacks, and sends [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Suppress[/gold] to your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
On exit, deal [gold]Axe stacks[/gold]*[blue]8[/blue] damage to the enemy with the highest HP.
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_AXE.title: Axe
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_GUN.description:
A [gold]Stance[/gold]. Playing a card with the [gold]Firearm[/gold] tag grants [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Firearm[/gold], up to [blue]6[/blue] stacks.
On exit, deal [blue]4[/blue] damage to ALL enemies, repeated [gold]Firearm stacks[/gold] times.
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_GUN.title: Firearm
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_SWORD.description:
A [gold]Stance[/gold]. Playing a card with the [gold]Blade[/gold] tag grants [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Blade[/gold], up to [blue]1[/blue] stack.
On exit, gain [blue]2[/blue] Energy.
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_SWORD.title: Blade
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_LING_HUO.description:
When a card with the [gold]Flexible[/gold] tag is sent to your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] by an effect, play it.
If an effect is noted after [gold]Flexible[/gold], the card is not played; instead, those effects are triggered.
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_LING_HUO.title: Flexible
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_YING_DUI.title: Response
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_YING_DUI.description: Before you are attacked by an enemy, trigger the effect noted after Response.
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_FORESEE.description: Look at the top X cards of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], choose 1 card to add to your hand, and send the rest to your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_FORESEE.title: Foresee
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_DENG_CHANG.title: Debut
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_DENG_CHANG.description: When this card is added to your [gold]Hand[/gold] by an effect, play it, then return it to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. If an effect is noted after [gold]Debut[/gold], the card is not played; instead, those effects are triggered.
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_STANCE.description:
There are four [gold]Stances[/gold]: [gold]Dagger[/gold], [gold]Axe[/gold], [gold]Firearm[/gold], and [gold]Blade[/gold].
You can only have one of these [gold]Stances[/gold]. Playing a [gold]Stance[/gold] makes you enter that Stance.
If you already have another [gold]Stance[/gold], you first exit the original [gold]Stance[/gold] and trigger its exit effect, then enter the new [gold]Stance[/gold].
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_STANCE.title: Stance
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_RETRIEVER.description: Add several cards from a certain [gold]card pool[/gold] to your hand.
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_RETRIEVER.title: Retrieve
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_YA_ZHI.description: Suppress is not shuffled into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]; when [gold]Exhausted[/gold], it is played.
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_YA_ZHI.title: Suppress
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_ZHU_LEI.description: Tearlaments cards, including Tearlaments Monsters, Tearlaments Spells, and Tearlaments Traps.
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_ZHU_LEI.title: Tearlaments
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_ZHU_LEI_MO_FA.title: Tearlaments Spell
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_ZHU_LEI_XIAN_JING.title: Tearlaments Trap
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_ZHU_LEI_GUAI_SHOU.title: Tearlaments Monster
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_ZHU_LEI_XIA_JI_GUAI_SHO: A Tearlaments Monster other than a Tearlaments Fusion Monster.
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_ZHU_LEI_RONG_HE.descrip:
This effect can be activated only once per turn per card name. When this card is sent to your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] by an effect, choose any number of cards from your [gold]Hand[/gold] or [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] to return to your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], then add 1 [gold]Tearlaments Fusion Monster[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Tearlaments Havnis: 2 [gold]Tearlaments Monsters[/gold]
Tearlaments Kaleido-Heart: 1 [gold]Tearlaments Reinoheart[/gold] + 2 [gold]Tearlaments Monsters[/gold]
Tearlaments Rulkallos: 1 [gold]Tearlaments Havnis[/gold] + 1 [gold]Tearlaments Monster[/gold]
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_ZHU_LEI_RONG_HE.title: Tearlaments Fusion

YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_YI_JIE.description: Anomaly cards, including Anomaly Monster cards and Anomaly Spell/Trap cards.
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_YI_JIE_GUAI_SHOU.title: Anomaly Monster
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_YI_JIE_MO_XIAN.title: Anomaly Spell/Trap

YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_TONG_DIAO.title: Synchro
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_TONG_DIAO.description:
If the card triggering Synchro is not a [gold]Tuner[/gold] and your hand has a Tuner card, choose 1 Tuner card in your hand. Move this card and the chosen card to your Discard Pile, then apply the following effect: if the Tuner is Level 4, add 1 [gold]Sangenpai Bident Dragion[/gold] to your hand; if the Tuner is Level 7, add 1 [gold]Sangenpai Transcendent Dragion[/gold] to your hand.
If the card triggering Synchro is a Tuner and your hand has other cards with a Level that meets it, choose 1 card in your hand with a Level, move this card and the chosen card to your Discard Pile, then apply the following effect: if the chosen card is Level 3, add 1 [gold]Sangenpai Bident Dragion[/gold] to your hand.
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_TIAO_ZHENG.title: Tuner
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_SAN_XING.title: Level 3
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_SI_XING.title: Level 4
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_QI_XING.title: Level 7
YUNO_MOD_KEYWORD_SHI_XING.title: Level 10
